entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is VeloBot. How can I assist you today?
I need to return something. It's a VeloBand Pulse. I bought it a couple of weeks ago.
Okay, I can help you with that. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?
It's [customer email address]. And hurry up, I don't have all day. I tried to use this VeloBand Pulse and it's just not working for me. It's inaccurate.
Thank you. I've located your order. I see you purchased a VeloBand Pulse. Our standard return policy is 90 days for most items. Is there anything wrong with the VeloBand Pulse?

Yes! As I said, the pulse readings are completely off. I wore it on a run and it was showing a heart rate of 60! I'm in shape, but I'm not *that* in shape. I want to return it. This is ridiculous. It's been about 15 days since I got it. Surely that's within your return timeframe.

Yes, absolutely. Since it's well within our 90 days return policy, I can process that for you right away. I apologize that the VeloBand Pulse wasn't working as expected. Let me generate a return shipping label for you.
90 days? Okay, good. Finally, some decent customer service. So I just print the label, slap it on the box, and send it back?

That's correct. I've emailed you the return label. Just repackage the VeloBand Pulse securely, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the item, we'll process your refund.
Great. Thank you. How long will the refund take?
You should see the refund reflected in your account within 7-10 business days after we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for your help. I was worried I was going to be stuck with a dud smart watch.

You're welcome! We appreciate your business. Have a great day! If you have any further questions, you can refer to our website or call back. In the meantime, your order qualifies for our standard return policy. Bye
